title: Using the work of others — Penrose Health
instructions: Evaluate how the auditor of **Penrose Health** may use the work of others.

rows.label: Using internal audit's inventory test counts at low-risk locations after evaluating its competence and objectivity
rows.explanation: Low-risk, low-judgment areas suit internal audit's work.

rows.label: Having internal auditors decide the allowance for doubtful accounts is reasonable
rows.explanation: Significant judgments must be made by the external auditor.

rows.label: Relying on a SOC 1 Type 2 report covering January–September, plus a bridge letter and inquiries for October–December
Relying on a SOC 1 Type 1 report to reduce control risk for operating effectiveness
Referring to the auditor's own valuation specialist in an unmodified report
rows.explanation: References to specialists aren't made in an unmodified opinion.

rows.label: Testing the complementary user entity controls listed in the SOC report
rows.explanation: User controls are needed for the service organization's controls to work.
